narr: A thunderstorm along the International border at Nogales, Arizona produced flash flooding as runoff moved from Nogales, Sonora into Nogales, Arizona.
ev: The Nogales Wash at Nogales exceeded bankfull at about 8 feet causing flooding in the Morley Road region of Nogales.
